title: Study of Drug X in Type 2 Diabetes
inclusion_criteria: Adults 18-75 with type 2 diabetes mellitus and HbA1c between 7.0 and 10.5.
exclusion_criteria: Pregnant patients; eGFR < 30; history of ketoacidosis.

title: Hypertension Outcomes with Agent Y
inclusion_criteria: Adults with essential hypertension on stable therapy for 4 weeks.
exclusion_criteria: Secondary hypertension; NYHA class III/IV heart failure.
